description: A SET Format 2 (index-arithmetic) amount that is an index-name or an index data item. §1985:VI.6.23.2 prints Format 2's amount as {identifier-3 | integer-2} and §1985:VI.6.23.3 SR3 requires "Identifier-3 must reference an elementary numeric integer"; an index-name and an index data item are neither, so the amount is refused at COBOL-85 (kb/Work PB5421). ISO/IEC 1989:2002 (14.8.35.1) prints arithmetic-expression-2 in that position, which admits them (the SET sending operands of VCR row 7.52 (c), the row set-arithmetic-expression-2002 for the other operands). The row exists so the refusal names the operand it refuses, an index, where set-arithmetic-expression-2002's words (an expression, a non-integer, a zero or negative integer) name three forms the operand is not (kb/Work PB5593). Gated in ONE place, SetBinder.GateCobol85IndexAmount, once per statement after the format is selected.
display: a SET UP BY or DOWN BY amount that is an index-name or an index data item (the 1985 amount is an elementary numeric integer)
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.52 (c) - the SET sending operands, a COBOL-85 restriction read from the printed formats (kb/Work PB5421, PB5593)
